subject: POC kickoff & timeline - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@acme.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Intro + demo - next steps (POC)

Thanks again for your time today - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of call:
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for high-throughput document ingestion and retrieval-augmented generation for Acme's support assistant.
- Scope for POC: 2 ingestion pipelines (Zendesk export + S3 bucket), embeddings + semantic search, 1 production-like RT configuration for 3 concurrent users.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Retrieval latency: median < 200ms for top-5 embeddings queries under observed QPS.
2) Relevance: > 80% acceptance rate from Acme SME team on 50 eval prompts.
3) Cost baseline: token+infra cost estimate within 20% of our projected model.

Proposed timeline & milestones:
- Kickoff week of Jun 22 - setup infra, data access, and initial ingestion.
- Week 1 (Jun 22-26): Ingest sample data, baseline embeddings, basic search.
- Week 2 (Jun 29-Jul 3): Integrate RAG pipeline, initial relevance checks, weekly readout.
- Week 3 (Jul 6-Jul 10): Latency/load tuning, quality evals, final readout week of Jul 13.

Ownership / contacts:
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, POC lead), Alex Martinez (Solutions Engineer, infra/troubleshooting).
- Acme: Dana Hughes (PM, success criteria owner), Tom Becker (Eng, infra/data access).

Immediate asks for kickoff:
- Dana/Tom: Confirm success criteria above or share edits by EOD Wed (Jun 17).
- Provide S3 path or sample Zendesk export and a service account with read access (or a secure transfer link).
- Availability for a 30-min kickoff on Tue Jun 23 or Wed Jun 24.

I attached a short POC-plan (outline + checklist) and a Drive link with the evaluation template. Happy to adjust.

Attachments: [POC-plan-acme-v1.pdf (pdf)]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmePOC

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Intro + demo - next steps (POC)

Thanks Marissa - this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Success criteria: we agree with the three bullets, but can we make the relevance threshold 75% (acceptance on 50 eval prompts) for the initial readout, with a stretch goal of 80% for the final?
- Data access: we can provide an S3 prefix (s3://acme-support/poc-sample/) and will create a read-only IAM role for the Redwood team. Tom, can you confirm timing for the role?
- Security/compliance: Procurement will want the SOC2 questionnaire answered - I'll loop procurement if needed, but can we get a pre-filled questionnaire or an FAQ?

On kickoff timing - Tue Jun 23 10:00am PT works for us. Please send calendar invite.

Dana
Dana Hughes
Product Manager, Customer Experience
Dana.Hughes@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@acme.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Intro + demo - next steps (POC)

Perfect - thanks for the quick turn. We're fine with starting with 75% relevance as the initial readout threshold and 80% final stretch. I'll update the POC doc. 

Tom - when you have a moment, can you:  
- Confirm that the read-only IAM role will be available by Mon Jun 22 EOD?
- Share any network restrictions (IP allowlist) so we can pre-configure endpoints.

Next steps from Redwood: 
- I'll send a calendar invite for Tue Jun 23, 10:00am PT (30 min) for kickoff. Agenda: introductions, access checklist, quick walkthrough of the POC plan, confirm evaluation prompts and owners, and align on weekly check-in cadence.
- Alex will prepare an initial ingestion checklist and a list of required sample data fields.
- We will upload an updated POC-plan v1.1 to the Drive after kickoff.

Attachment: [POC-plan-acme-v1.pdf]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AcmePOC

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Hughes <dana.hughes@acme.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RE: Intro + demo - next steps (POC)

Quick operational note from infra: 
- For the POC we recommend deploying inference in us-west-2 to match Acme's existing compute footprint and reduce egress.
- We'll provide a small dedicated test pool (1x A10G equiv) to reproduce latency under expected load. If Acme wants to run a larger scale stress test, we can expand but will need a short SLA for capacity.
- Alex - please coordinate on the exact IAM role ARN and any IP allowlist details.

Vivek
Sr. Ops, Redwood Inference
